Anna / team — great to meet earlier today. Notes and action items below: 

Meeting highlights:
- Architecture: For Private deployments we support an egress-only VPC NAT configuration (optional). Hosted defaults route outbound through Redwood-managed NATs; customers can configure outbound proxies in Private.
- Presigned URLs: Our runtime can generate presigned S3 URLs if customer integrates object storage through our connectors; by default presigned URLs are generated by customer code. We'll call this out in the SIG workbook.
- Logs & retention: Egress events emitted to our centralized telemetry pipeline include: timestamp, request_id, model, destination IP/hostname (redacted in samples), bytes_out, user_id_hash, and auth_scope. Default retention: 90 days in hot storage; 365 days archived (configurable for Private).
- Evidence provided: sanitized egress log sample (redwood-egress-log-sample.txt), access matrix (access-matrix-2026-11.pdf), and a short slide (uploaded to shared drive).

3) Crescent: confirm whether they require log field-level hashing or full IP redaction for the SIEM ingest (Anna) — due Mon 11/30.
4) If Crescent requests longer retention for Private, we'll scope a retention addendum and estimated cost (Dylan / infra) — initial estimate due 12/04.
